relationships.evidence_quote: the somas of PL-ACC projection neurons exhibited a lower level of spontaneous Ca2+ in SNI mice compared with sham mice

relationships.subject: prelimbic VIP interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: In mice with neuropathic pain, acute chemogenetic activation of PL VIP neurons significantly increased Ca2+ activity in PL-ACC projection neurons

relationships.subject: prelimbic VIP interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: acute activation of PL VIP interneurons increases pyramidal neuron activity, including those projecting to the ACC, and attenuates pain-like behaviors

relationships.subject: prelimbic VIP interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: daily activation of PL VIP interneurons for 1 week after SNI was sufficient to preserve PL outputs to the ACC and prevent the development of neuropathic pain

relationships.subject: PL-ACC projection neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: a single CNO injection to acutely activate PL–ACC projection neurons significantly reduced the activity of L5 pyramidal neurons in the ACC to the sham level

relationships.subject: PL-ACC projection neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: the PL primarily sends glutamatergic projections onto GABAergic neurons in the ACC, providing a feedforward inhibition to ACC local circuits

key_findings: Nerve injury reduces prelimbic VIP interneuron and L5/PL-ACC projection neuron activity in both sexes, leading to ACC pyramidal hyperactivity via loss of feedforward inhibition onto ACC GABAergic neurons.
Chemogenetic activation of PL VIP interneurons restores PL-ACC output, normalizes ACC hyperactivity and attenuates or prevents neuropathic pain-like behaviors.
